CommunityApplications.Profile:
This repository provides the **rathole** plugin for unRAID.
rathole is a lightweight, high-performance reverse proxy written in Rust. It exposes local services on a NAT network to a public server, which can be useful for remote access to home-lab services without opening ports on your router.
This plugin installs the rathole **client** on your unRAID server, adds a webGUI page to edit `rathole.toml` (server address, port, and service mappings), and provides start/stop/restart control of the daemon.
For support or questions, please open an issue on GitHub or visit the unRAID forum topic.
